about.headline: Visual discernment, crafted technique, and direct communication
paragraphs: I'm Denis Alexandrescu, a graphic designer and audiovisual editor based in Spain. Holding a degree in Audiovisual Communication, I have worked professionally and independently with clients since 2024.

I work without account managers or middlemen: you discuss, review, and decide directly with me. I don't promise magic formulas; I guarantee aesthetic rigor, on-schedule deliveries, and an orderly process from start to finish.

I have built projects across diverse fields such as language coaching, luxury watch trading, and real estate. This versatility demands that I approach every brief from a blank canvas, without prefabricated templates or forced aesthetics.

projects.description: Logo design for a language coaching professional.
projects.startingPoint: Anna needed a logo for her practice as an executive language coach.
execution: The mark merges two shapes into one: a line-art brain transitioning into a solid speech balloon. Thinking in a language and speaking it, precisely what distinguishes a language coach from a traditional academy.

The wordmark is lowercase with a rounded geometric sans: warmth and accessibility over academic rigidity. The three words descend in weight—«anna» being the boldest, «coaching» light—ensuring the personal name leads, as the coach herself is the brand.

The palette is built upon violet shades against deep black, with the speech balloon rendered in the brightest tone to capture immediate focus. A deliberate departure from the standard institutional blues and reds used across the language learning sector.

projects.description: Complete brand identity for a luxury watch trading business.
projects.startingPoint: L'Heure d'Or buys and sells luxury timepieces. It needed a full identity system, not just a standalone logo.
execution: The brand operates on two distinct assets that function independently: a crowned monogram where the letter H connects with an overarching curve, and a high-contrast uppercase serif logotype with pronounced brackets.

In watch trading, clients buy and sell high-value assets, requiring the brand to radiate solvency at first glance. Classic luxury signifiers—crown motif, gold on black, bracketed serifs—were embraced without irony: establishing the mark as timeless rather than a transient newcomer.

The identity was developed in four distinct colorways—gold on black, black on white, white on grey, and gold on bronze—to guarantee legibility across signage, single-ink print stationery, and high-contrast digital media.

projects.description: Short-form video content showcasing properties across social media.
projects.startingPoint: Templum needed to showcase its properties on social platforms through video format.
execution: Each piece was constructed from multiple architectural shots edited over a dedicated voiceover, with custom script writing and voice recording. Modern soundtrack pacing drives the walkthrough, while high-contrast subtitles ensure clarity without audio.
